title: agrostis schultesii
intro: Agrostis schultesii, commonly known as the Schultes' bentgrass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a type of cool-season grass that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Agrostis schultesii include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its high content of antioxidants and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
